jlens
JSONata that shows its work.
Query and transform JSON, and see why each result came out the way it did. Passes the official JSONata test suite.
Rust Python Java WebAssembly CLI + LSP VS Code
$ jlens eval -f rule.jsonata -i order.json --explain result: {"action":"FREE_SHIPPING","code":"OK_200"} • $total := $sum(items.(unitPrice * quantity)) = 57000 ✔ Authorized customer → true ✔ Customer not blocked → true ✔ Minimum order grand total → true (57000 > 50000) ✔ Order category check → true ✔ Electronics group → true ✔ $electronics > $total * 0.30 + 1000 → true (37000 > 18100)
